market_definition: The Japan Fashion E-Commerce Market covers the online sale of apparel, footwear, and fashion accessories through online marketplaces, company- or brand-owned websites, social commerce/media, and mobile applications in Japan. The market assessment includes demand by product type, price range, age group, payment method, end user, sales channel, and geographical region, alongside pricing, consumer behaviour, supply chain and logistics, digital shopping experience, and competitive developments. BY PRODUCT TYPE: Apparel (Men's Wear - Formal, Casual, Sportswear, Ethnic; Women's Wear - Dresses, Tops, Bottoms, Ethnic, Maternity; Kidswear - Infants, Toddlers, Teen Segment); Footwear (Sports Shoes, Casual Footwear, Formal Footwear, Slippers/Slides); Accessories (Bags and Wallets, Belts and Scarves, Hats and Headwear, Watches and Jewelry); Sunglasses and Eyewear. BY PRICE RANGE: Premium, Mid-Range, Economy. BY AGE GROUP: Gen Z (18-24), Millennials (25-40), Gen X (41-56). BY PAYMENT METHOD: Debit/Credit Cards, E-Wallets, Bank Transfer, Cash on Delivery, Others (Cryptocurrency, etc.). BY END USER: Men, Women, Children. BY SALES CHANNEL: Online Marketplaces, Company / Brand-Owned Websites, Social Commerce / Media, Mobile Apps. BY REGION: Kanto, Kansai, Chubu, Kyushu and Okinawa, Rest of Japan. KEY EXCLUSIONS: offline-only fashion retail sales not captured through the defined e-commerce channels; non-fashion merchandise outside the defined apparel, footwear, accessories and eyewear categories; general e-commerce sales unrelated to fashion products; standalone technology, logistics and payment services not included as fashion merchandise sales; other products and services outside the defined Japan Fashion E-Commerce Market scope. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - ONLINE FASHION SELLER: a company headquartered in Japan that sells apparel, footwear, fashion accessories or eyewear to consumers through online channels it operates - online fashion marketplaces, multi-brand fashion retail and e-commerce groups, footwear and fashion specialty e-commerce, and fashion brand owners / omnichannel players (the report's four company groups). EXCLUDED companies: offline-only retailers; general or non-fashion e-commerce sellers; technology, platform, logistics, fulfilment, payment and marketing service providers; B2B-only wholesalers and OEM manufacturers; companies headquartered outside Japan.
who_is_included: ONLINE SELLER DEFINITION (e-commerce market): a company that SELLS the market's products to consumers through online channels it operates - online marketplaces and shopping platforms, online retailers, multi-brand retailers and select shops with their own online store, and brand owners selling through their own website, app or social commerce. EXCLUDED: offline-only retailers; general e-commerce sellers not focused on the market's products; technology, logistics, payment and marketing service providers; B2B-only wholesalers and manufacturers. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER. Blank or NPD in a contact column means no published evidence was found - it is never a guess.
